# gemini-vertex-switch

> Zero-dependency Python client for Gemini generateContent that switches between AI Studio and Vertex AI using google-genai environment rules. Python package `trysac-gemini-vertex-switch`, import name `gemini_vertex_switch`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, secret handling, URL validation, limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
